text:
Complications of preterm birth were the leading cause of death for children under five in 2017, at roughly 16% of under-5 deaths. Pneumonia was nearly tied and was the top cause for children aged 1 to 59 months. The shared note overstates one point: neonatal deaths were about 45–47% of under-5 deaths, not most of them, and preterm complications edged out pneumonia only narrowly.

CONFIDENCE: 75
